thread:
Asha (PM): Heads-up — final facilitation rota for annual planning week. I sketched coverage and day-zero prep tasks. Please claim or flag conflicts by EOD Thu. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/planning-week

Liam (Eng): I can own the tech check on Mon morning and be the AV backup during hybrid sessions.

Noah (Design): I'll take the kickoff design vision slot and prep the deck. Can someone share a slide template?

Priya (Ops): I'll handle catering and on-site logistics. Need dietary prefs and arrival ETA by Fri.

Elliot (Product Ops): I'll coordinate facilitator rotation across breakout rooms and own the facilitator spreadsheet. Posting in a sec.

Maya (Director): @Asha do we have an on-site backup facilitator if sessions run long?

Asha (PM): Good call — @Liam would you be backup for overruns?

Liam (Eng): Yep I can.

offsite-bot: calendar event created: "Annual Planning — Day 0 Tech Check" Mon 09:00–10:30 PT (rooms A/B).

Asha (PM): Also need a crash plan if streaming drops: fallback Zoom link + Room 3 AV as fallback. @Priya please verify spare mics and a laptop with HDMI.

Priya (Ops): Noted. I'll do a mic + laptop check Mon 08:30 and post checklist here.

Noah (Design): Sharing the vision deck draft in #planning-docs in ~30m. Will use the new 2-up template.

Elliot (Product Ops): Breakout facilitators listed: @Sam, @Rina, @Jules — confirm you can run two concurrent breakout slots? I'll DM assignments.

Sam (Eng): Morning ok, afternoon I have a conflict — can swap with @Jules if needed.

Rina (Research): Morning confirmed. Afternoon I'd prefer to be backup if possible.

Asha (PM): Swap accepted, Sam -> morning, Jules -> afternoon. I'll update the spreadsheet.

Liam (Eng): Quick tech config note — for hybrid, set streams to 720p to reduce bandwidth. Runbook snippet:
```
streaming:
  resolution: "720p"
  fallback: "audio-only"
  max_clients: 250
```

Maya (Director): Reminder — every initiative needs a 1-pager with success criteria in the pre-reads bucket. Please drop by Tue COB.

planning-bot: Reminder set — upload pre-reads 48h before your session.

Asha (PM): Day-zero agenda (high level):
1) Room setup & signage
2) Tech checks (stream + mics)
3) Facilitator tabletop rehearsals
4) Final materials sync + print run
5) Welcome kit assembly
Who can be on-site at 08:00 for setup?

Priya (Ops): I'll open doors at 07:30 to receive vendors. Sending entry codes via DM.

Elliot (Product Ops): I'll bring printed facilitator cards, 2 spare HDMI adapters, and a battery pack.

Sam (Eng): Bringing a spare handheld mic and an HDMI switch.

Noah (Design): Do we have parking passes for external partners/vendors?

Priya (Ops): Yes — 3 guest passes. I'll DM details and pickup time.

Rina (Research): Can we get a whiteboard kit per breakout? Markers + sticky dots for voting.

Priya (Ops): Ordering now, will confirm delivery ETA.

Asha (PM): If you take a facilitation slot you must attend the rehearsal Mon 16:00 PT. If you can't make the rehearsal, flag now so I can assign a rehearsal buddy.

Sam (Eng): 16:00 rehearsal works for me.

Maya (Director): I can't make the rehearsal window — will trust my co-facilitator to run the drill.

Asha (PM): Noted. I'll pair Maya with @Noah for rehearsal.

Elliot (Product Ops): Also: print run checklist — 1 facilitator card per facilitator, 1 laminated run-of-show, 2 spare name badges per room.

Priya (Ops): Got it. Printing Tuesday morning.

Asha (PM): Final — I'll lock the facilitator rota tomorrow at noon unless there are conflicts. If you claim a slot, please update the sheet and add your pre-read link. :thumbsup:

Noah (Design): Added deck link to the sheet.

Liam (Eng): Posted the tech checklist and the HDMI/adapter inventory.

offsite-bot: Event reminder scheduled for all attendees 24h prior to start.

Asha (PM): Thanks team — this is shaping up. Any last-minute asks call them out here or DM me.
